nodes.rationale: Stage 1 minimizes sum r_s to proven optimality (gap forced to 0, CP-SAT status must be OPTIMAL, stage 2 uses <=), stage 2 minimizes the real objective; big-M with calibrated P exists only in the plan for comparison. sum r_s > 0 provably means no assignment could do better (REVIEW S-07).

nodes.label: Storage cooldown enforced in both stages (S-04)
nodes.norm_label: storage cooldown enforced in both stages (s-04)
nodes.rationale: _fixed_zero_pairs yields (d,s) pairs where s is in cooldown_storages or storage_accepts_format is false, giving x=0; a resident disk is never fixed away. Not replicated: heuristic._repair's cooldown exemption, so the MILP is narrower in that edge case.

nodes.label: apply enforces payback verdict (S-02)
nodes.rationale: _apply_payback_gate never calls execute_plan for a move in rejected_moves, or any move when aggregate_ok is false, reporting skipped/refused outcomes with the same shapes execute produces.

nodes.label: Draining sources excluded for the rest of the run
nodes.norm_label: draining sources excluded for the rest of the run
nodes.rationale: A draining outcome adds its source to drained_storages; later moves touching it are skipped without an API call via _drained_skip_outcome, since the storage lock persists during the wipe (REVIEW S-05).

nodes.label: Executed moves record balance and cooldowns for both storages
nodes.norm_label: executed moves record balance and cooldowns for both storages
nodes.rationale: _record_executed_moves counts moved and draining outcomes from final ExecutionResult.outcomes and calls with_recorded_balance and with_recorded_cooldown (disk plus both source and destination storage, REVIEW S-03); state is saved once via save_locked_state.

nodes.label: Four-condition move completion criterion
nodes.rationale: A move is done iff the task succeeded, the source volume is absent from content, the VM lock is clear, and elapsed drain >= min_wipe_seconds (added after VM 101's back-to-back lock timeout). Hitting the source-release timeout yields draining, not failure.

nodes.label: Saturation check is planning-time only
nodes.rationale: Neither executor re-checks the section 7.3 ceiling during execution, leaving concurrency_ok point 4 a documented gap.

nodes.label: Task-level lock timeout retry
nodes.rationale: _is_task_lock_timeout matches PVE's can't-lock-file exit status; _execute_one_move and the concurrent poller reissue move_disk up to task_retry_limit times, the concurrent path spacing retries by poll cycle instead of sleeping inline.

nodes.label: Two failure modes, one in-flight UPID mechanism
nodes.norm_label: two failure modes, one in-flight upid mechanism
nodes.rationale: Engine crash mid-move and two DRS instances both leave a move_disk task running unknown to a run; a local inflight_upids trace and a cluster-wide /cluster/tasks scan detect either before planning; the affected vmid is excluded, never force-cancelled.

nodes.label: Reserve-override exemption is an outcome trigger
nodes.norm_label: reserve-override exemption is an outcome trigger
nodes.rationale: evaluate_plan_payback exempts the aggregate ratio test when final_shortfall_bytes < current_shortfall_bytes (sum r_s, via reserve.total_shortfall_bytes on the executed endpoint); the hard per-move max_single_move_duration rule is not exempt. It replaced a per-move resolves_reserve_violation flag that was a provable superset.

nodes.label: Reading degrades, writing raises
nodes.rationale: load_state never raises (missing/corrupt file becomes empty_state) because losing state.json is safe but not free; save_state_atomic raises StateError because a write is something the caller actively asked for.

nodes.label: Rename-detaches-flock bug and in-place locked write
nodes.norm_label: rename-detaches-flock bug and in-place locked write
nodes.rationale: Writing lock metadata via temp-file plus rename replaced the inode with a never-locked one, silently breaking mutual exclusion; the fix writes in place (lseek, write, ftruncate, fsync) into the locked fd.

nodes.label: Cooldowns are not a gate
nodes.rationale: Per-disk and per-storage cooldowns decide individual movability, like (C2) pin reasons, not a group-wide act/no-act verdict, so they live in topology (disk pin) and heuristic (storage destination filter).

nodes.label: Reserve override bypasses hysteresis
nodes.rationale: Any storage with ReserveStatus.violated forces act=True immediately, bypassing drift and imbalance: safety is not subject to hysteresis.

nodes.label: Repair is unconditional, not weight-driven
nodes.rationale: _repair runs before _descend and fixes (C5) violations regardless of beta/gamma weights; it judges candidates by group-wide total shortfall (not the source's) to avoid oscillation, and reserve_penalty_term reports only a residual repair could not fix.

nodes.label: Protocol-typed session for network-free tests
nodes.rationale: PrometheusClient accepts a structural _SessionLike Protocol with a single get() so tests inject a small dataclass instead of mocking requests.Session, honouring the rule that no test talks to a real Prometheus.

nodes.label: Confirm callback lives in cli.py
nodes.rationale: execute.ConfirmCallback returns y/n/a/q; only cli.py may call input(), so the prompt and retry-on-typo live in the cli confirm factory.

nodes.label: Monitoring status file for check_statusfile
nodes.rationale: statusfile.py is two pure halves (build_run_status level policy, render_status text) plus write_status_file as the only side effect; the format is dictated by the check_statusfile plugin, written on every apply run so mtime means the timer still fires; errors are logged and swallowed.

nodes.label: bundle_reference_now rebased capture instant
nodes.rationale: bundle_reference_now returns manifest capture.synthetic_now_epoch, the capture time shifted by a whole-week offset so only hour-of-day and day-of-week survive; cli._now_for substitutes it under --replay.

nodes.label: Free-text finding messages redacted broadly
nodes.rationale: _redact_finding_message substitutes any registered vmid number or node name in every verify_metrics message; over-redaction is the safe direction.

nodes.label: Mapper pseudonyms with order-independent vmid probing
nodes.norm_label: mapper pseudonyms with order-independent vmid probing
nodes.rationale: vmid pseudonyms hash into 100..999999 with linear probing on collision; register_vmids sorts unseen vmids once so mapping is order-independent; node/storage/tag are pure functions of the salt.

nodes.label: Three modules with one-way dependencies
nodes.rationale: anonymize is pure and shared by collect and tests/corpus/validate_corpus.py; collect talks to the cluster and never imports replay; replay imports collect only for hash_query_text/hash_label_name so the cache-key scheme is written in one place.

nodes.norm_label: strictly-sequential order as concurrent launch queue
nodes.rationale: schedule.py only ever produces a sequential order; execute.py's concurrent executor uses that order as a FIFO launch queue rather than schedule.py reasoning about overlapping in-flight windows.

nodes.label: Anonymization fails closed
nodes.rationale: Unresolvable inputs return None and callers drop the record rather than passing through or inventing placeholders; a smaller bundle is preferred to a leak (unmapped means dropped).

nodes.label: Controllable now for deterministic bundles
nodes.rationale: Byte-identical bundles require every query to depend on capture_bundle's now parameter; compute_disk_coverage, _check_observed_spacing and compute_group_load gained an optional now and cli._now_for supplies it under --replay.

nodes.label: One-pass fetch with bounded thread pool
nodes.norm_label: one-pass fetch with bounded thread pool
nodes.rationale: build_topology fetches in stages; the per-VM fetch (_fetch_vm) runs over a bounded ThreadPoolExecutor while the join (_join_vm_disks) is single-threaded in original order so results are identical regardless of read_workers (REVIEW P-02).

nodes.label: Size resolution: content authoritative, config fallback
nodes.norm_label: size resolution: content authoritative, config fallback
nodes.rationale: _resolve_disk_size_and_format uses content size, then approximate-size, then VM-config size=; a managed disk's size is read from its own VM's node because PVE 9.2 qcow2-on-LVM reports exact size only on the node with the LV active.

nodes.label: Storage pattern expansion once, before validation
nodes.norm_label: storage pattern expansion once, before validation
nodes.rationale: /.../ patterns in groups[].storages are expanded via re.fullmatch against cluster storage ids; a literal overwrites a pattern match; zero matches, a disabled storage, or two patterns claiming one storage are fatal, with cross-group uniqueness checked afterwards. Patterns skip the images-content check by design.

nodes.label: CBC direct unscaled transcription and pulp compatibility
nodes.norm_label: cbc direct unscaled transcription and pulp compatibility
nodes.rationale: CBC writes identical constraints with plain floats; variables built via pulp.LpVariable directly (not add_variable, which is absent in trixie's pulp 2.7.0, REVIEW S-01) with the DeprecationWarning suppressed; PulpSolverError becomes None.

nodes.label: Feasibility constraints built once per stage
nodes.norm_label: feasibility constraints built once per stage
nodes.rationale: _cpsat_feasibility_constraints and _cbc_feasibility_constraints build (C1)/(C3)/(C4)/(C5) identically for both lexicographic stages, called twice with fresh variables; (C3) honours objective.affinity_counts_pinned_disks.

nodes.label: Command handler dict, not an if-chain
nodes.norm_label: command handler dict, not an if-chain
nodes.rationale: _COMMAND_HANDLERS maps subcommand to handler; not-yet-implemented handlers come from a closure factory so an unassigned command fails honestly instead of KeyError.

nodes.label: --group filtered once after build_topology
nodes.rationale: _filter_groups is the one place --group is read; a name matching no group raises DrsError instead of an empty report (REVIEW R-03).

nodes.label: gates only reads last_balance
nodes.rationale: gates.py never writes state; with_recorded_balance is called once in cli._handle_apply after a group executes a migration.

nodes.label: Startup scan folds excluded vmids before planning
nodes.norm_label: startup scan folds excluded vmids before planning
nodes.rationale: _handle_apply calls _reconcile_inflight_and_fold_exclusions right after building the client, folding discovered vmids into exclude.vmids for every mode including dry-run, reusing the existing (C2) pin.

nodes.label: Mutable state box narrow exception to functional style
nodes.norm_label: mutable state box narrow exception to functional style
nodes.rationale: _InflightStateBox is a mutable holder so a closure deep in execute_plan can write state; _handle_apply's finally saves state_box.value to avoid clobbering a newer inflight write.

nodes.label: show-load gate line is diagnostic
nodes.rationale: show-load reuses GateDecision.reason verbatim, but plan/apply run a fresh authoritative gate evaluation at plan or apply time.

nodes.label: _plan_group shared planning pipeline for plan and apply
nodes.norm_label: _plan_group shared planning pipeline for plan and apply
nodes.rationale: _plan_group is the single gate-solve-schedule-payback pipeline reused by plan, apply and explain; _GroupPlan carries each stage result or None; apply acquires the state lock before touching PVE/Prometheus.

nodes.label: final_assignment is the schedule's own truth
nodes.norm_label: final_assignment is the schedule's own truth
nodes.rationale: ScheduleResult.final_assignment applies order to the current placement; callers reporting after-state must use it rather than the heuristic target (REVIEW R-02).

nodes.label: Concurrent executor with strict FIFO
nodes.rationale: _execute_concurrent is a separate non-blocking loop (via _check_lock_once and _poll_move_once) used only for auto mode with caps above 1; _advance_pending only considers pending[0]; a stop condition drains in-flight moves rather than abandoning them.

nodes.label: Errors are not mismatches
nodes.rationale: _pre_move_refusal decides fatal errors (API failures, unsized volume) become failed with always_stop/abort_run rather than replan_needed, since a re-plan would hit the same wall; ExecutionResult.aborted stops group visiting.

nodes.label: Injectable Clock for wait loops
nodes.rationale: Every wait loop measures elapsed time via clock.now() with an injected Clock so a fake clock exercises real timeout arithmetic at zero wall time; _REAL_CLOCK avoids a B008 default.

nodes.label: No double counting of in-flight mirror targets
nodes.norm_label: no double counting of in-flight mirror targets
nodes.rationale: Under concurrency _inflight_target_volids excludes at most one volume per in-flight move (not in launch baseline, same VM, size matching a mirror target size) from the listing sum, while _move_charge_bytes decides the charge, so each mirror is counted once.

nodes.label: Pre-flight re-validation against live cluster
nodes.rationale: _preflight re-fetches node, config, running status, snapshots, pending changes and exclusion tags for every move, bypassing the planning cache; any mismatch stops the group with replan_needed rather than patching the plan.

nodes.label: vm_config returns pending value; vm_pending exposes both
nodes.norm_label: vm_config returns pending value; vm_pending exposes both
nodes.rationale: GET .../config merges queued changes, showing the pending value not the one in effect; only GET .../pending exposes both, feeding topology.pending_disk_reasons for the (C2) pin.

nodes.label: D is every disk placed, pinned or not
nodes.norm_label: d is every disk placed, pinned or not
nodes.rationale: D includes every disk placed into a group even if (C2) pins it; pinned and config-excluded disks still count toward reserve (C4)/(C5) and the kappa fragmentation term. An earlier plan draft wrongly called config-excluded disks foreign.

nodes.label: Format eligibility via storage_accepts_format
nodes.rationale: Storage carries storage_type and allowed_formats from a fixed table (block-backed raw only, file-backed qemu-img formats, plain lvm also qcow2); storage_accepts_format is the one predicate used by both MILP backends and the heuristic to fix x=0 for ineligible targets.

nodes.label: Pending-change pin
nodes.rationale: A disk with a queued pending edit or delete is pinned because move_disk does not reconcile the pending entry; pending_disk_reasons is public so execute._preflight reuses the identical parser.

nodes.label: Pin priority order in _pin_reason
nodes.rationale: Pin reasons are checked in a fixed order: config exclusion, snapshot/orphan companion, pending change, per-disk cooldown, VM lock, unusedN; the first match wins.

nodes.label: Shared (C4)/(C5) evaluator in reserve.py
nodes.rationale: compute_reserve_status computes used, shortfall = max(0, used + R_s - capacity) and violated = shortfall > 0; it is its own module so heuristic can evaluate a candidate assignment through the storage_of override, and optimize encodes the equivalent bound as a scaled linear constraint.

nodes.label: U_ext: everything not referenced
nodes.rationale: U^ext per storage is the sum of every content entry whose volid no placed disk referenced (orphans, templates, foreign volumes, unfetched VMs), matching section 5.1.1 read literally.

nodes.rationale: The plan requires the unit conversion at the call site and nowhere else; move_disk divides by 1024 once and forwards format only when explicitly passed.

nodes.rationale: The node-scoping selector needs every cluster node, not only nodes visible on vm_resources/storage_resources; an idle node dropped from the filter would quietly under-count history.

nodes.rationale: Datastore.Audit alone yields a clean 200 with empty data; topology would then silently compute U_ext as zero. A token needs Datastore.Allocate on each managed storage.

nodes.rationale: proxmoxer offers one attribute-chaining interface over HTTPS, openssh or paramiko, so a deployment that cannot open the API port changes only a build_client keyword argument.

nodes.norm_label: lock read from vm_config, no extra call
nodes.rationale: _join_vm_disks reads the VM lock from the config already fetched, so planning-time lock detection costs no API call; status/current is used only in execute's pre-flight.

nodes.rationale: _apply_ticket_refresh_seconds reaches into proxmoxer internals to shorten renew_age; guarded getattr/hasattr make it a silent no-op if internals change.

nodes.label: verify_metrics runs six checks
nodes.rationale: verify_metrics composes focused _check_* functions: metric-name existence, sample series, device-label collision, coverage, observed scrape spacing; ok is true iff no error-level Finding and is the single definition used for the exit code.

nodes.label: Replay clients are real subclasses
nodes.rationale: ReplayPveClient and ReplayPrometheusClient subclass the real clients with an inert transport so every existing type annotation accepts them; move_disk/task_status raise PveApiError; vm_pending treats a missing file as nothing pending only for pre-3.8 bundles; the Prometheus range branch trims a stored superset span and raises BundleError outside it.

nodes.label: HoltWintersForecaster optional statsmodels fallback
nodes.rationale: statsmodels is imported only inside predict(); fewer than 2*seasonal_periods samples or a missing import falls back to QuantileForecaster with a warning. Upper bound is point estimate plus residual_z times residual stdev.

nodes.label: Per-disk summed forecast upper bound
nodes.rationale: storage_upper_bound forecasts every disk on a storage independently then sums the upper bounds, deliberately conservative (assumes every disk peaks together), instead of forecasting the already-summed series.

nodes.label: SeasonalNaiveForecaster hour-of-day buckets
nodes.rationale: Groups samples by hour-of-day, median as point estimate and upper quantile as bound; an empty bucket returns Forecast(0.0, 0.0) rather than raising.

nodes.label: Node-scoping selector tiers
nodes.rationale: resolve_node_selector prefers metrics.extra_selector verbatim, else an escaped node-name alternation from PveClient.node_names, else none; needed so sum by (vmid, device) does not merge multiple clusters. A cluster-label middle tier was removed after operator correction.

nodes.label: PromQL construction as pure string builders
nodes.norm_label: promql construction as pure string builders
nodes.rationale: build_rate_promql sums by (vmid, device) collapsing node labels; build_quantile_over_time_promql wraps it; raw_metric_name is the single mapping from raw field to configured metric name.

nodes.label: Single _get request path with uniform MetricsError
nodes.norm_label: single _get request path with uniform metricserror
nodes.rationale: instant_query, range_query and label_values all funnel through _get, which is the one place every failure mode becomes MetricsError; typed Any because payload shape differs by endpoint.

nodes.label: compute_disk_load_series shares the blend
nodes.rationale: The same normalize-weight-rescale blend (_blend_loads/_combine_raw_values) is run per timestamp for the forecaster; no min_coverage applied; feeds the saturation guard through forecast.storage_upper_bound.

nodes.label: compute_group_load: raw series to l_d
nodes.rationale: compute_group_load takes a built Group and PrometheusClient and returns GroupLoad (per-disk l_d, per-storage L_s/u_s, u*, idle); it never touches the PVE API and is called once per group.

nodes.label: Coverage rejection excludes disk from group totals
nodes.norm_label: coverage rejection excludes disk from group totals
nodes.rationale: A disk below window.min_coverage is excluded from T_g/O_g/B_g entirely so it cannot bias others' normalized share; its own l_d comes from last_known_loads or a flagged 0.0 with flagged_reason, never silently treated as zero load.

nodes.label: Idle group when T_g = 0
nodes.rationale: GroupLoad.idle is true when every accepted disk's raw_t is zero; an all-rejected group also reads idle, harmless since both mean do not act.

nodes.label: Six group-scoped queries
nodes.rationale: Six raw quantities fetched via one instant query each scoped by group_query_selectors, batching vmids by VMID_QUERY_BATCH_SIZE; an unscoped cluster-wide aggregation timed out on a several-hundred-VM cluster (REVIEW Q-02); read/write time converted ns to seconds engine-side.

nodes.label: Utilization is load per declared capability, not byte fill
nodes.norm_label: utilization is load per declared capability, not byte fill
nodes.rationale: u_s = L_s / c_s with capability_weight c_s; u* = sum l_d / sum c_s (C6). Solvers re-sum the same l_d against candidate assignments.
